{{Quote|I learned to love the Silver Sea.|Mon Mothma|<ref name="TKT">''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]''</ref>}}
The '''Silver Sea''' was a large body of [[Water/Legends|water]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]]. The planet's [[Capital/Legends|capital]], [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]], was located along its shores, and its [[Hanna City Harbor|harbor]] was home to thousands of [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] [[Boat/Legends|ships]]. Multiple reefs were located in the [[Ocean/Legends|sea]], which [[Pilot/Legends|pilot]] [[Gavin Darklighter]] enjoyed visiting while diving. The [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic's]] leader, [[Mon Mothma/Legends|Mon Mothma]], grew up in Hanna and retained fond memories of the Silver Sea long after [[Gender/Legends|she]] left.

==Description==
[[File:SilverSeaTEGtPM.png|thumb|left|200px|The Silver Sea and Hanna City]]
The Silver Sea was a body of [[Water/Legends|water]] with rippling banks along which lay [[Hanna City/Legends|Hanna City]],<ref name="CatCW" /> the [[Capital/Legends|capital]] [[City/Legends|city]] of the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Chandrila/Legends|Chandrila]], as well as Hanna's metropolitan area, which ran along the sea for thirty-six [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]], eighteen of which were the city's downtown area.<ref name="Strongholds">''[[Strongholds of Resistance]]''</ref> The sea contained multiple reefs that teemed with life,<ref name="Ruin">''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]''</ref> including a spectacular<!-- This is the word used in CATCW. It's not a NPOV violation. --> reef located just offshore.<ref name="CatCW" /> The [[Jhanjaari River]] flowed into the Silver Sea from the nearby [[Lake Sah'ot]], which was separated from the sea by a gentle slope.<ref name="Strongholds" /> [[Balmgrass/Legends|Balmgrass]] and [[bristing]] grew along the seashore, which was also inhabited by [[Squall (species)|squalls]] and [[fecklen]]s.<ref name="NJO Rebirth">''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]''</ref>

==History==
{{Quote|I find that making my home over in the image of where I lived in better times is good for my sanity.|Mon Mothma explains why her quarters are decorated like her seaside home|<ref name="TKT" />}}
[[File:MonMothma-RotJAVA.png|thumb|right|200px|Mon Mothma grew up near the Silver Sea.]]
Hanna City was originally established as a [[Fishing/Legends|fishing]] village that made use of the Silver Sea. By the [[Imperial Era/Legends|Imperial Period]], thousands of [[Fish/Legends|fishing]] trawlers were based in the city's [[Hanna City Harbor|harbor]], which was located in the midst of [[Beach/Legends|beaches]], [[reef diving pier]]s, and wharves on Hanna's seaside.<ref name="Strongholds" /> [[Mon Mothma]], [[Head of State/Legends|leader]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], grew up in Hanna City and, over [[Time/Legends|time]], became fond of the Silver Sea.<ref name="TKT" /> In [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]],<ref name="KrytosDate">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[X-Wing: The Krytos Trap]]'' to [[7 ABY/Legends|7 ABY]]</ref> New Republic [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] complimented the [[Ocean/Legends|ocean]]-themed decor in Mothma's quarters and asked for confirmation that Mothma had grown up in a Chandrilan port city. Mothma confirmed that [[Gender/Legends|she]] had, described her feelings about the sea, and stated that she had designed her current residence to resemble her home.<ref name="TKT" />

By [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]],<ref name="RuinDate">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'' dates the events of ''[[The New Jedi Order: Dark Tide II: Ruin]]'', by which point [[Gavin Darklighter]] had dived near the Silver Sea, to [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]]</ref> [[New Republic pilot/Legends|New Republic pilot]] [[Gavin Darklighter]] had come to love diving on Chandrila with his [[Sera Faleur Darklighter|wife]] and was especially fond of the life that teemed in the Silver Sea's reefs.<ref name="Ruin" /> The ranch occupied by [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]] was within sight of the Silver Sea, which gleamed with [[Chandrila (star)|sunlight]] when it was visited by the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Kyp Durron]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]].<ref name="NJO Rebirth" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Silver Sea was first mentioned in the [[1998]] reference book ''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]'', written by [[Daniel Wallace]].<ref name="TEGtaPM">''[[The Essential Guide to Planets and Moons]]''</ref> It made its first appearance in [[Greg Keyes]]' [[2001]] novel ''[[The New Jedi Order: Edge of Victory II: Rebirth]]'', the second book in the ''[[Edge of Victory Duology]]'' and ninth overall in the ''[[Star Wars: The New Jedi Order]]'' series.<ref name="NJO Rebirth" />
